title: EvidenceItem
description: A single piece of evidence submitted for a claim assessment. Each item is keyed to a playbook evidence type.

evidence_key.description: Key matching a playbook evidence_matrix entry, e.g. 'structural_engineer_report'

display_name.description: Human-readable label, copied from playbook evidence matrix

present.description: Whether this evidence has been provided for this claim

notes.description: Assessor notes about this evidence item

file_ref.description: Path or storage key of the evidence document, if attached

date_obtained.description: When this evidence was obtained (not when damage occurred)

conflicts_with.description: Keys of other evidence items this item conflicts with. Used to raise EXPERT_CONFLICT flag.

examples.display_name: Photographs of damage taken before repairs
examples.notes: Customer provided 12 photos taken day after storm. External damage clearly visible.

examples.display_name: Weather data for property postcode on date of loss
examples.notes: Met Office data for SW1A 2AA on 2024-01-15. Max gusts 62 mph.
Insurer surveyor concluded damage from wear and tear, not storm.
